====================

The Senior Full-Stack Java Engineer will architect, develop, and maintain enterprise-grade applications while driving cloud modernization initiatives. This role bridges robust legacy architectures—including enterprise batch systems, server-side web platforms, and mainframe integrations—with cloud-native microservices on AWS. The ideal candidate pairs deep expertise in Java/Spring and Oracle database persistence with modern event-driven architectures, automated test pipelines, and AI-assisted development workflows.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

**Salary**: $95-$100K

**Role Type**: Remote

**Experience Level**: 7 years Java experience, 3 years Full Stack experience

**Program Context**
===================

**Background and Introduction**

Customer Inquiry and Claims Response System (CICRS) is used by the indemnity claims process to provide customers with an efficient means of settling their claims and service refunds. Provides an efficient process for settling indemnity claims and service refunds for insured mail, improving customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

CICRS is designed to pay or deny indemnity claims against the Postal Service when there is loss or damage to insured articles in the mail stream. Once a claim is received into the CICRS system, the claim data is processed, and a determination is made to pay or deny the claim within 2 days.
